|translation='''Title:''' Tauntaun Bones.

'''Card text:'''
Use 1 Force to deploy on table. Each time the opponent draws destiny, follow these instructions by that value. Zero: Take the top Used Pile card into hand. Two: Lose 1 Force. Two again: Activate 1 Force. Three: Lose this Effect. Four: Retrieve the top Lost Pile card. Five: Deploy one character without spending Force. Six or more: Nothing.

'''Lore:'''
The bones of a tauntaun represent both death and life. They are the death of the prey and the life of the predator. They symbolize the ebb and flow of the Force in all things.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Printed subtype is エフェクト.
